challengeFindings.title: A workflows fail usage error unrelated to --next-step (e.g. a non-numeric --step-number thrown by buildComment after failState already wrote) triggers the Failure Path retry, which appends a second workflow-failed row and drops a valid NEXT_STEP from the final message

A cancelled (or action-required / stale) check in the Step 2 CI wait counts as failed, so ship names /bkit-debug {FID} for a CI run that never went red, while the Step 10 gate sends a cancelled run (exit 15) to the Failure Path with no next step
A --next-step value holding a backtick breaks out of its code span and posts live markdown (links, images, @ mentions, HTML) in the failure comment under bkit's tracker token

challengeFindings.title: A Failure Path that passes the fence's `--next-step="{NEXT_STEP}"` unsubstituted (or holds `/bkit-debug {FID}` verbatim) gets exit 2 from the flag parser's placeholder guard, not exit 6, so the retry never fires and the run ends with no workflow-failed row, the lock still held, and no failure comment or bkit:failed label
